_howto: One entry per simulator, in the order they should appear. 'url' must be a full https:// link. Each one opens in a new tab.

simulators.title: BronchSim
simulators.description: Free virtual bronchoscopy trainer that runs in your browser, built on a 3D airway from a real CT. Explore freely, quiz yourself on each bronchus, or try timed navigation and foreign body challenges. Nothing to install.

simulators.title: MV-Ed Ventilator Simulator (VentCoach)
simulators.description: Interactive ventilator simulator from The MV-Ed Project with VC, PC, PSV, and PRVC modes, live waveforms, ABGs, and alarms. Work through guided case-based lessons from basic settings to hypoxemia and extubation readiness, or run it freely.
